purpose: Exact post-side-symmetry engine behaviour, captured before any parameter was wired. Default parity is judged against this. If a fixture drifts, the wiring is wrong — this file is not re-recorded.

reFreezeHistory.why: engine behaviour changed for a reason unrelated to parameter wiring: three root-caused repairs to the two independent Historical V5 measurement failures. The script itself requires --force only in that case and requires the reason stated in the commit.

overtimeSeedsReSearched.why: the repairs moved the outcome stream, so the prior seeds reach regulation. The script instructs finding a new seed rather than relaxing the requirement.
